definitions.value: Average within-sector percentile of book equity / market cap and TTM net income / market cap
definitions.momentum: Total return from t-12 to t-1 months
definitions.profitability: TTM gross profit / total assets (SEC companyfacts, point-in-time)
definitions.investment: Total asset growth over 1 year (lower ranks higher)
definitions.issuance: 1-year log change in split-adjusted shares outstanding (lower ranks higher), penalty for listings younger than 5 years
definitions.insiders: Net opportunistic insider buys (count of insiders) over 180 days; routine traders (same calendar month 3 years running) excluded
definitions.short_interest: Short shares / shares outstanding (FINRA, twice monthly); lower ranks higher
definitions.sue: (EPS_q - EPS_q-4) / std of the prior 8 such changes; only within ~95 days of the filing
definitions.lowvol: Average within-sector percentile of 1-year daily volatility and 2-year beta (lower ranks higher)

cites.value: Fama & French (1992, 1993): book-to-market and earnings yield
cites.momentum: Jegadeesh & Titman (1993): 12-month return skipping the latest month
cites.profitability: Novy-Marx (2013), 'The Other Side of Value': gross profit / assets
cites.investment: Cooper, Gulen & Schill (2008), 'Asset Growth and the Cross-Section of Stock Returns'
cites.issuance: Loughran & Ritter (1995), 'The New Issues Puzzle'; Pontiff & Woodgate (2008)
cites.insiders: Cohen, Malloy & Pomorski (2012), 'Decoding Inside Information': opportunistic trades
cites.short_interest: Boehmer, Huszar & Jordan (2010); Asquith, Pathak & Ritter (2005)
cites.lowvol: Frazzini & Pedersen (2014), 'Betting Against Beta'; Ang et al. (2006)
